p1: I am applying for the advertised role at your company, which I found through Jobright. I hold an M.S. in Applied Computer Science from Northwest Missouri State University and have hands-on experience building, integrating, and documenting AI agents, document Q&A systems, and machine learning models that sit on top of existing services. I would like to bring that work to your team and keep learning from engineers who ship production systems.
p2: At Mondee I built grounded document question-answering on Azure AI Search and GPT-4o, then split retrieval errors from generation errors so reviewers could see where an answer failed; that tracing cut hallucination escalations by about 40 percent and raised groundedness scores by 35 percent. I also trained routing and classification models in PyTorch and scikit-learn, lifted routing accuracy by 18 percent, and reported precision, recall, and error cases each sprint so the next change was based on evidence rather than guesswork.
p3: On ParseDoc.ai I extract layout and fields from long PDFs so downstream agents and search indexes receive structured records instead of raw page dumps, then wire those pipelines into n8n and Azure Search with auditable traces. I have packaged scoring services with Docker on AWS, written setup notes that shortened local-to-demo handoff, and used Copilot and Cursor to turn natural-language specs into first-pass flows. I treat documentation, testing, and secure data handling as part of the build, and I work well with non-engineering stakeholders.
p4: I would welcome the chance to contribute to your team, learn its production practices, and grow with your company. I can start on your timeline and am happy to walk through any of the projects above. Thank you for your time; I look forward to speaking with the team.
